text_simplified: Parents must raise their children with wisdom and gentleness, avoiding hitting and harsh punishment. It is important to choose righteous companionship for children, as it influences their behavior and deen. They should also protect their daughters and provide a safe environment for them, while guiding their children toward goodness. Tarbiyah through good example and rifq (gentleness) is better than violence.
